quote.purpose: Use current build-scoped Source read models and Cube projections only. This mode is intended before quoting Source portfolio, Contract 360, or Cube-derived figures.

declaredBasisDifferences.explanation: source.contract_360 counts contract rows after supplemental rows are excluded. Source V4/Cube can count contract families, where one family can span several rows. State the basis instead of treating the two counts as a conflict.

source.contract_360 counts distinct vendor_ref values in the Contract 360 read model. Source V4/Cube can count normalized vendor families or vendor portfolio rows. State the basis instead of silently picking one.
Contract 360 read models sum total committed value over the row-level contract register. Source V4/Cube can sum normalized contract families. State the basis before quoting total committed value.
Contract 360 read models count auto-renewing contract rows. Source V4/Cube can count auto-renewing contract families. State the basis before quoting auto-renew counts.
